documents.title: Expense reimbursement policy
documents.content: EXP-30. Employees must submit business travel expense claims within 30 calendar days after returning. Itemized receipts are required for hotels, rail, airfare and meals. Claims are filed in the finance portal; approved reimbursements are paid in the next payroll cycle.

documents.title: Annual leave policy
documents.content: LEAVE-14. Employees request annual leave in the HR portal at least fourteen days before the first day away. Managers approve according to team coverage. Unused entitlement follows the published carry-over limit.

documents.title: Password reset procedure
documents.content: PASS-SELF. Use the self-service identity portal to reset a forgotten password. If multi-factor verification is unavailable, contact the IT service desk and verify your employee identity. Never ask a colleague to share credentials.

documents.title: Customer incident response
documents.content: INC-P1. For a customer-facing outage or severe production degradation, call the incident hotline immediately, open a priority-one incident and notify the on-call incident commander. Do not wait for the next business day.

documents.title: Removable media and customer data
documents.content: SEC-USB. Customer files, exports and personal data must not be copied to USB drives or other removable media. Use the approved encrypted collaboration service and report accidental transfers to Security.

documents.title: Work equipment requests
documents.content: EQUIP-REQ. Request laptops, monitors, headsets and ergonomic accessories through the procurement catalogue. A manager must approve non-standard equipment before the order is placed.

documents.title: Remote working policy
documents.content: REMOTE-3. Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager agreement. The team calendar must show remote days, and confidential calls require a private location.

documents.title: Parental leave guidance
documents.content: FAMILY-LEAVE. Employees expecting a child or adopting should contact People Operations to plan statutory and enhanced parental leave. Notice dates and pay options depend on the expected placement or birth date.

documents.title: Software and vendor purchasing
documents.content: BUY-SOFT. New software subscriptions and vendor purchases require a procurement request, security review and budget-owner approval before accepting terms or entering payment details.

documents.title: Phishing and suspicious messages
documents.content: PHISH-REPORT. Do not open links or attachments in a suspicious message asking for credentials or payment. Use the mail client's Report Phishing button, then contact Security if any information was entered.
